english.title: Placed alcohol outside detention centre with intent - immigration
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) placed alcohol outside a detention centre, namely **(..SPECIFY..), intending that it should come into the possession of a detained person there
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 5(2) and (4) of Schedule 12 to the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999.

english.notes:
(i) See offence wordings H3478 and H3479 re bringing alcohol into a detention centre/to a detained person and offence wording H3481 re allowing alcohol to be sold in a detention centre.
(ii) See paragraph 5(5) for definition of alcohol for the purposes of this offence.
